Supported deployment tiers. Hosted multi-tenant deployment is absent until P07.

``hosted`` is a single-user deployment behind an HTTPS reverse proxy (see
docs/DEPLOYMENT.md): public bind, Host-header allowlist, HTTPS-only web origins and secure
cookies. It is not a multi-tenant or SSO deployment.

info.description: refactorX control-plane API: authentication (access token or optional demo account), readiness, projects and sample projects, ZIP/local-runner intake, frozen snapshots, scans (PMD, ESLint, Opengrep, Trivy, structure, graph) with coverage, findings, issues, comparison and exports, AI review (when configured), validated fixes and GitHub connections with branch and pull request reviews. Source-only analysis: nothing is built or run.
info.title: refactorX API

get.description:
Download a finished run as JSON (``crp-ai-run-export/v1``) or its AI findings as SARIF.

Kept separate from scan exports: these are AI results with their evidence class.
Whether AI review can run on this server, its limits and this month's usage.

post.description: Sign in to the shared demo account (demo workspace only) when the demo is enabled.

get.description: Public: which sign-in methods the web UI should offer (no credentials required).

post.description: Exchange the local development token for an HttpOnly session cookie.

delete.description: Delete a workspace, its checks and the copies its checks scanned (the upload stays).

get.description: AI fix suggestions requested in this workspace, newest first (optionally one file).

post.description:
Ask AI for candidate fixes of one finding, made for the file as it is in the workspace.

Only when the project allows AI and the server has a provider with budget left. Candidates
are checked like automatic fixes before anyone can apply them; nothing changes until then.
Apply one checked AI candidate to the workspace (recorded as an AI change).
Re-check the workspace: its edits on a copy of the upload, scanned and compared.

get.description:
Download the workspace: a patch (``git apply``) or one commit (``git am``), only the
changed files, the full project, or a summary. Every download names its exact upload.
The uploaded and current text of one file (for the editor and the comparison).

put.description: Save an edit (or a new file). Policy flags are returned, never silently applied.

post.description:
Apply the deterministic fix of each selected finding (or every finding of one rule).

Each fix is computed against the upload and applied to the workspace's current text: at its
exact place, or where the same lines now are; otherwise it is skipped with the reason.

get.description: The upload's findings as a work queue, with their outcome from the latest check.

post.description:
Open one pull request with the checked workspace changes on the reviewed branch.

The branch must still point at the reviewed commit; otherwise 409 ``stale_patch``. The same
content opens one pull request (asking again returns it); nothing is ever merged.

get.description: Bounded, authorized source lines as JSON strings (never HTML); likely secrets are masked.
Fixes that can be prepared for this finding (deterministic recipes), with reasons.

post.description: Prepare a fix for the finding with a deterministic recipe (applied to a copy only).

put.description:
Change the replacement lines of the fix. The lines it replaces and the file stay fixed;
the policy still applies and validation starts over.

get.description: The patch as a unified diff for ``git apply -p1`` / ``patch -p1`` on exactly this upload.

post.description:
Open a pull request with this validated fix on the reviewed branch (never merged).

The branch must still point at the reviewed commit; otherwise 409 ``stale_patch``: review
the newer commit, move the fix there and check it again.

Move the fix to another upload of the same project as a new, unvalidated proposal.

Works only when the changed lines are still present unchanged (conflict otherwise).

get.description: Change summary with validation evidence and known risks (``crp-fix-export/v1``).

post.description: Run the validation ladder for the fix's current patch (copies only; no code executed).

get.description: Process liveness only; reveals no dependency details and needs no credentials.

Check real dependencies; 503 with the same body when any check is not OK.

Only credentials are verified (no database lookup) so the report works during outages.
Scope policy and quotas. The local runner applies the same policy before uploading.

put.description: Local-runner manifest (declared hashes and local exclusions). Verified, never trusted.

post.description: Idempotent: repeated calls return the current state and never start a second validation.

Issue a 15-minute ticket that authorizes uploading this intake's archive only.

Hosted deployments upload directly to the API host (bypassing the web host's proxy limits),
so the ticket replaces the same-site session cookie for that single request.

Create the built-in sample project (a small, deliberately flawed online store) and start
freezing its snapshot. Poll the returned intake, then start a scan of its snapshot.

delete.description:
Permanently delete a project with its uploads, reviews, findings, issues and architecture
maps, and reclaim their storage. Refused while a review or upload check is running.

put.description: Allow or stop sending masked code excerpts of this project to the AI provider (admins).

get.description: Newest runs first; ``finding_id`` narrows to second opinions on that finding.

post.description:
Start a bounded AI run: a question, a review of one finding, or a review of files.

Refused unless an admin switched AI review on for the project and the server has a
configured provider with monthly budget left. Only masked excerpts of the chosen upload are
sent, and every call is accounted.
Open a workspace on an upload (default: the latest one).
Review the default branch's newest commit, or a pull request, now.

delete.description: Disconnect: reviews stop; earlier snapshots, scans and reviews stay as history.

patch.description: Change what is reviewed and published (admins; versioned and audited).

put.description: Connect a repository from a linked installation and start its first (full) review.

get.description: Latest frozen snapshot and scan for dashboard cards (real counts only).

post.description:
Start a baseline scan of a frozen snapshot. Repeating a request with the same
Idempotency-Key returns the existing scan instead of starting another one.
Idempotent cancellation; completed engine results stay visible, the scan ends CANCELED.

get.description: Compare a target scan with a base scan of the same project (any snapshots).
Server-sent events with monotonic IDs; reconnect with Last-Event-ID to resume.
Download the scan as the platform JSON export or as SARIF 2.1.0 (terminal scans only).

Filtered findings ordered by severity, path and line (published results are immutable,
so offset cursors are stable within a scan).
Files added, changed, removed and renamed between two uploads (or commits).
Both versions of one file, as text, for the side-by-side view.
Files/modules that (transitively) depend on the node, computed at file level.
Nodes and edges within ``depth`` hops (in either direction), bounded by ``limit`` nodes.

delete.description: Unlink an installation: its repositories disconnect; reviews stay as history.

post.description: Refresh the repository list from GitHub (admins).
Begin verified linking: returns the GitHub page where the admin confirms access.
Finish linking with GitHub's one-time code: link the installations this user can access.
